verdict.rationale: Kimi documents API parity only in narrow areas. File upload and question answering is explicitly stated to be the same in the API, and the Admin API covers console tasks such as members, projects, keys, billing, usage and audit logs. However, the probe found no public API for the assistant app itself, and the many UI features listed in help (agent mode, deep research, PPT assistant, scheduled tasks, memory, webpage building and deployment) have no documented API equivalents. Missing for 10: API access to the assistant's agent mode, deep research, PPT, scheduled tasks, memory, skills and plugins, and web deploy; a documented full UI-to-API parity statement; independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Kimi intelligent assistant can upload files and answer questions based on those files. The Kimi API offers the same functionality.
The Kimi Admin API lets organization administrators manage members, invitations, projects, and inference API keys programmatically, and query billing, usage, and audit logs
